parentNote.en: Every question is answered in the app. Each goal has a short home activity: say the words aloud together, and let your child guess first.
parentNote.ar: كل الأسئلة الطفل بيحلها جوه البرنامج، ولكل هدف نشاط قصير في البيت. قولوا الكلمات بصوت عالي مع بعض، وسيبوا طفلك يتوقع الأول.

steps.title: What kind of sentence?
steps.prompt: A monster lives inside the washing machine. Which is right?
steps.hint: Could this happen in our home?
steps.explanation: A monster in the washing machine could not really happen, so it is fantasy.
steps.shortExplanation: A monster in the washing machine could not really happen, so it is fantasy.

steps.title: The end of a sentence
steps.prompt: What goes at the end of every sentence?
steps.hint: It is the last carriage of the sentence train.
steps.explanation: Every sentence ends with a full stop.
steps.shortExplanation: Every sentence ends with a full stop.

steps.title: More than one box
steps.prompt: Write the word for more than one box.
steps.hint: Clap two box-es. Box ends with x.
steps.explanation: Box ends with x, so more than one is boxes.
steps.shortExplanation: Box ends with x, so more than one is boxes.

steps.title: Which part?
steps.prompt: Aqsa wakes up in her own bed. Which part of the story is it?
steps.hint: Is it how the story starts or how it finishes?
steps.explanation: Waking up in bed finishes the story, so it is the end.
steps.shortExplanation: Waking up in bed finishes the story, so it is the end.

steps.title: Write it correctly
steps.hint: The word I and the name of a place both need capitals.
steps.explanation: I and Dubai both need capital letters: the word I and a place.
steps.shortExplanation: I and Dubai both need capital letters: the word I and a place.

steps.title: It already happened
steps.prompt: We play in the park. Make it yesterday: write the ending.
steps.hint: Yesterday? Then add the time machine ending.
steps.explanation: We played in the park. Played tells us it already happened.
steps.shortExplanation: We played in the park. Played tells us it already happened.

steps.title: Start a recount
steps.prompt: Which word could start a recount?
steps.hint: A recount tells what happened in order.
steps.explanation: First is a time word. It can start a recount.
steps.shortExplanation: First is a time word. It can start a recount.

source.answerKeyText: Any of: First, Yesterday, Last week, On Monday, Then

steps.title: Rhymes with ten
steps.explanation: Ten and hen both end with en, so they rhyme.
steps.shortExplanation: Ten and hen both end with en, so they rhyme.

source.answerKeyText: Any rhyme: hen, pen, men, when (a made-up rhyme like "zen" is fine too)

steps.title: Number name: 7
steps.explanation: Seven is s, e, v, e, n.
steps.shortExplanation: Seven is s, e, v, e, n.

steps.title: Find the noun
steps.hint: A noun is a person, a place or a thing.
steps.explanation: School is a place, so it is a noun. Run and jump are verbs.
steps.shortExplanation: School is a place, so it is a noun. Run and jump are verbs.

goalActivities.text: Make up silly sentences together and decide each time: real or fantasy?
goalActivities.textAr: ألّفوا جمل تضحّك مع بعض، وكل مرة قرروا: حقيقي ولا خيال؟
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
